offices.text: makes a man witty and bold

notes.text: appears angelic, but is in truth foul and obscure
earl and mighty prince (S); the 1904 rank list omits him from the Earls

goetia.textus: (22.) Ipos. —The Twenty-second Spirit is Ipos. He is an Earl, and a Mighty Prince, and appeareth in the form of an Angel with a Lion’s Head, and a Goose’s Foot, and Hare’s Tail. He knoweth all things Past, Present, and to Come. He maketh men witty and bold. He governeth 36 Legions of Spirits. His Seal is this, which thou shalt wear, etc.
forma: He is an Earl, and a Mighty Prince, and appeareth in the form of an Angel with a Lion’s Head, and a Goose’s Foot, and Hare’s Tail.

reticentia: the witnesses are silent on his truthfulness
